sections.heading: Retail technology services for connected operations
sections.body:
Retailers and fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) and consumer packaged goods (CPG) businesses need to connect demand with stock, fulfilment and customer engagement. Retailers focus on connected shopping and service channels; brands and distributors also need coordinated partner orders, inventory and supply information.

Linkfields combines application and platform integration, governed forecasting and workflow automation with proprietary software and reusable accelerators. Planning and service owners remain accountable for decisions, with consent and customer-data controls built into engagement workflows.

sections.heading: What we deliver
sections.description: Agree input systems, accountable decision owners and acceptance measures. Evaluate forecasting and customer engagement against agreed operational baselines.

items.title: Demand and replenishment planning
items.description: Sales history, stock and promotional signals need a consistent basis for planning.
items.bullets:
Workflow – Prepare demand data and evaluate forecasting models for replenishment review.
Control – Planners approve actions; agree evaluation periods and model/data-quality checks.
items.footText: Forecast error, planning rework and replenishment decisions.

items.title: Inventory and fulfilment exceptions
items.description: Inventory, warehouse and order records can diverge across fulfilment channels.
items.bullets:
Workflow – Connect stock movement and order status; model inventory scenarios where data supports them.
Control – Supply teams own exceptions and validate simulation assumptions.
items.footText: Stock reconciliation, fulfilment exceptions and resolution time.

items.title: Retailer and distributor order connectivity
items.description: Partner orders and invoices often cross applications with different owners and formats.
items.bullets:
Workflow – Connect portals, ERP and order/invoice workflows, with shared status and exception queues.
Control – Sales and operations owners approve adjustments; agree partner access boundaries.
items.footText: Order completeness, invoice rework and exception age.

items.title: CRM-led commerce and service journeys
items.description: Shopping, marketing and assisted service need consistent customer and order context.
items.bullets:
Workflow – Connect commerce, CRM and service hand-offs using approved engagement rules.
Control – Commercial owners approve campaigns; respect consent, data rights and escalation.
items.footText: Hand-off completion, repeat contacts and journey completion.

sections.heading: Software and accelerators for demand and fulfilment
sections.description: Match software and accelerators to your workflow and data requirements. Linkworks is available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without services.

items.title: Linkworks
items.description: Composable commerce and partner applications, with APIs and UI components where ERP or CRM does not fit.

items.title: Predictive Analytics Suite
items.description: Reusable demand-forecasting capability tailored to available sales, stock and demand data.

items.title: Digital Twin Suite
items.description: Inventory optimisation and forecasting simulation capability, subject to data readiness and validated assumptions.

items.title: Intelligent Workflow Automation
items.description: Reusable order and invoice routing, approvals and application integration, tailored to partner and operations controls.

sections.heading: Where do demand, stock and journeys disconnect?
sections.description: Use this example engagement pattern to scope a workflow, agree delivery controls and define acceptance measures before implementation.

items.title: Frame the workflow
items.description: Start with one planning, fulfilment, partner-order or customer-service constraint and its owner.
items.bullets:
Inputs – channel/SKU scope, systems and permitted sales/stock history
Output – workflow, data dependencies and decision map

items.title: Design controlled change
items.description: Agree customer-data consent, partner access, forecast evaluation and exception ownership before deployment.
items.bullets:
Artefacts – interface map, access matrix and review checkpoints
Quality gate – agreed tests and exception handling

items.title: Agree acceptance and operation
items.description: Define baseline, evaluation period and operational measures. Separate technology contribution from promotions and pricing when assessing commercial change.
items.bullets:
Artefacts – acceptance measures, release evidence and ownership plan
Commercial model – project, managed service or dedicated team

sections.note: We can agree an NDA before sharing confidential information. Share the process and systems involved, not customer records or confidential trading data.
